observed_reference.observation: A real pinned-tool run on 2026-09-15 produced 0 Circuit Engine errors and 0 Circuit Engine warnings. KiCad DRC produced 0 errors and 23 warnings: 13 generated-library registration warnings, 9 generated reference-text-height warnings, and 1 generated silkscreen-overlap warning. The warnings are retained, not suppressed; see known_findings.

known_findings.meaning: The pinned KiCad environment used for the check does not register the generated tscircuit footprint library, including the two generated mounting-hole footprints.
known_findings.action: Register or embed the generated footprint library before interactive library editing; this run does not suppress the warning.

known_findings.meaning: The engine emits generated reference fields at 0.4 mm, 0.5 mm, or 0.7 mm while this KiCad profile requires 0.8 mm silkscreen text.
known_findings.action: Adjust generated reference-field text in the engine/export path before treating the board as a production presentation.

known_findings.meaning: The generated U1 reference field overlaps the generated C1 F.Silkscreen segment.
known_findings.action: Resolve the generated reference-field placement in the engine/export path; it is not waived or suppressed here.

claims_not_made: This evaluation-only example is not fabrication-ready, a manufacturability verdict, or a signed release.
